scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Salamni, garuu foyyee kuni argatte ishee hinbaranu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Kana haa ta’uu akkan akkan guddaa keessanitti qabatte?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Kana malee guyyaa lamaa lamaa. Haa ta’uuf kana barbaachisaa, baruu ta’ani irraa jiru.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Hundarra. Foormii kuni qabaa fi baratee. Guyyaa kanarratti, dubartii irraa jiru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Galatoomi. Akkasumas deebi’aa foyyeen ishee hinbaranuu keessan deebifamu, baruu irraa jiru?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Akkasumas. Haa ta’uuf haa dhiyoo barbaraa irra jiruu, naa malee galmeessu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa muraasaa hin deemu haala dhaqaa ta’e ajajaa kana keessatti dubbii kennu godhu.

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Qabxichi irraa ta'e: eat / ate / eaten
Seenaa irraa ta'an akkasumas marroo marrootiin qabdu yoo ta'e

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa keessan nyaachuuf barbaadde?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Pasta dhaabbata, garuu guyyaa kana qofa guddaa barbaadu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Tokko tokko daanqii akkasumas sabjiin keessatti qabnu. Kana waan taaqaa ta'u danda'a.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Kana waan taaqaa ta'u. Gaaruu haqimmil barbaadan qofa dhiiraa irra jiru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Tokko tokko baakkii keessatti dubbifachuu qabaachuu waan hin dandeessu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, wanta taaqaa ta'u. Kanas hin nyaachuuf akkasumas kanarratti dubbachuu danda'u.

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee haala dhuunfatu kennaafi baay'ee barbaachisaa godhaa.
Dubbii tokko ilaalchisee malee haala dhuunfatu kennaafi baay'ee barbaachisaa godhaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Haala dhuunfatuu kennuuf barbaachisaa godhaa? Kompyuutaara keessani argamuu barbaadu, garuu shashii qoridoo ta'e.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee. Naa shufi. Badhaa tajjaa klikkeessu?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, klikkeessu. Garuu hojjii hinqabne. Dhok.si hin hojjamanii ta'u malee.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Cana godhi. Gaaffii wal hin qabnu ykn qabnu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Tole, naa dhufu. Garuu, kanas ajajaa ta'e, haqa na argamuu barbaadu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Naa shufi. Badhaa hojii naa shufi. Haa, kanarratti! Haqa hojjii!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: ‘Rent an apartment’ (mana dubbifama) jedhanii keessatti argama.
Afaan Ingilizii Amarkiin keessatti dhaabbata; Afaan Ingilizii Baraataa keessatti ‘flat’ jedha.
Dubbii mana kana qabduu hin qabne keessatti fayyadama.
Gurguddaa tokko; dubbii biyyaa irraa haasa’uuf yaadaa.
Qimaa keessatti kan qophaa’uudhaaf kennuuf fayyadama.
‘Suelo’ jedhamuu kan ta’e, garuu kanarrissummaa mana keessatti dheessii.
Du’aa ba’aa tokkoo hin ta’e kennuuf fayyadama.
Gurguddaa lamaa lamaa tokkoo hin ta’e kennuuf fayyadama.
Haalataa tokkoo hin ta’e kennuuf fayyadama.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Akkam, mana dubbifama kana hin beeki. Haa ta’e jiruudha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Haa, jiru. Dubbifama 800 doolaar biyyaa tokkoo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Qimaa kana ti’ootaafi simii qophaa’uu dha?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Deebii, ti’ii qophaa’uudhaaf. Simiin namoorra jedha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Akkaataa, dheessii mana keessaa? Du’aa suuparmaarkii ta’e?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Dheessii sadii mana keessaa ta’e, hanga suuparmaarkii lamaan ta’e. Hamma tokko guyyaa walii beeki’aa.
